name: dotnet-msix  
Packages MSIX apps: creation, signing, Store submission, App Installer sideload, auto-update.  
MSIX packaging pipeline for .NET desktop apps: package creation from csproj (`WindowsPackageType`) and WAP projects; certificate signing (self-signed for development, trusted CA for production, Microsoft Store signing); distribution (Microsoft Store submission, App Installer sideloading, enterprise via SCCM/Intune); auto-update (App Installer XML, version checking, differential updates); multi-arch MSIX bundle format (`.msixbundle`); CI/CD
